key_point: The real loss behind Final Fantasy VII
title: The real loss behind Final Fantasy VII
caption: Final Fantasy VII's theme of life and death came from its creator's grief. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #finalfantasyvii #squareenix

instagram.caption:
Final Fantasy VII is a story about life, death and memory, and it started with a personal loss.

Hironobu Sakaguchi's mother passed away while he was working on Final Fantasy III. He said he wanted to work through that loss by exploring the theme of life.

The result was the Lifestream, where every soul returns to the planet. It is why Aerith's death still hurts and still feels hopeful.

Did Aerith's death get you?
